buttonHint: Stores the effect in the hardware's own memory, so it keeps running after Hydraflow closes
title: Save to device
intro: Stores what's playing now in the hardware's own memory. It keeps working with Hydraflow closed and after turning off the PC. Only devices with that memory and a known way to write it can be selected.
mode.auto: Board mode similar to the effect
reason.ram: Corsair memory: the controller has no documented way to save (iCUE's device memory mode uses a closed protocol). It keeps the effect while Hydraflow is open.
reason.plugin: This device's plugin doesn't offer saving to its memory. When closing, it goes back to its own lighting.
reason.other: No saving to the device's memory.
warning: Saving replaces what was stored on the device. For the ASUS board, "When the app closes" becomes "Saved on device".
